snippet.title: REMOTHERED: RED NUN'S LEGACY DEV LOG | Midsummer Night's Scream: A HORROR GAME AWARDS SHOWCASE 2026
snippet.description:
Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy is the third and last installment in the iconic Remothered survival horror saga developed by Stormind Games.
In this dev diary, Chief Creative Officer Daniele Azara and Narrative Director Luca Esposito talk about the game's story, the new characters and the return of iconic ones.
Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy will be out later this year and is available to wishlist on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via https://remothered.com/wishlist
---
Originally aired during MIDSUMMER NIGHT'S SCREAM: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Monday 1 June 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
